record.question: The rigid body is replaced by two concent treated masses rigidly connected together. The system will be kinetically equivalent of the body if:
options: the mass of two masses is equal to the mass of rigid body
the centre of gravity of two mass system coincides with the centre of gravity of rigid body
the mass moment of inertia of the two mass system and the rigid body about centre of gravity are equal
